AND d.parent_id = #{parentId}

SELECT sd.dept_id, sd.dept_name, sd.org_num, sd.area_code, pait.ancestor_codes FROM sys_dept sd JOIN pa_addr_info_type pait ON pait.code = sd.area_code JOIN (SELECT area_code FROM sys_dept WHERE org_num = #{orgNum} AND dot_type = 1 LIMIT 1) base ON pait.ancestor_codes LIKE CONCAT('%', base.area_code, '%') WHERE sd.dot_type = 2;
